name: TryAMM TapPay
purpose: Original payment orchestration and merchant checkout layer for TryAMM covering tap-to-pay category flows, online checkout, payment links, wallets/OmniCredits, marketplace settlement, creator payouts and future global payment routing through licensed providers.
positioning: Build an original TryAMM payments experience inspired by modern merchant payment capabilities, not a copy of any competitor proprietary code, branding or UI.

phase1PartnerModel.rule: TryAMM orchestrates licensed/acquiring/payment providers rather than representing itself as an unlicensed processor or money transmitter.
capabilities: NFC/tap-to-pay through approved provider SDKs where available

coreFlows: merchant onboarding and KYC/KYB through regulated provider
paymentMethods: future regional methods through provider adapters

tapToPay.model: Use approved device/platform and processor SDKs for NFC/contactless acceptance. TryAMM provides merchant UX, orchestration, receipts, analytics, tipping, fee display and business tools around the regulated payment rail.
features: contactless card/wallet acceptance where provider/device supports it
fee pass-through option only where lawful and properly disclosed

feesAndProfit.principle: Never publish a payment price below actual processor/network/compliance/support cost. Platform fees must be lawful, disclosed and configured per market/provider.
feesAndProfit.pricingRule: CostOps computes minimum viable fee and target contribution margin before pricing is exposed. No hidden fee markups.

licensingPath: phase 2: expand multi-provider acquiring and regional payment methods
phase 3: obtain legal/regulatory advice for money-transmission/payfac/merchant-of-record or other roles before assuming them
phase 4: pursue licenses/registrations only where economically justified
